issue.detail: Spec says misprediction loads train_history concatenated with train_taken, but does not explicitly state whether train_history is shifted left by 1 (concatenation) or used as-is with train_taken in LSB. Rule assumes shift-left concatenation; alternative is direct load of train_history with train_taken ignored or ORed.
issue.spec_evidence: This is the history before the mispredicted branch (train_history) concatenated with the actual result of the branch (train_taken).
issue.alternative: Load history = train_history (no shift), ignoring train_taken.
